title: InvoiceAge billing rule body
description: sprk_policyversion.sprk_rulebody shape for sprk_ruletype = InvoiceAge (ebilling-r1 task 070; spec FR-24, design.md 6.1). 7. A line date is not more than N days before the invoice date.
